verdict.rationale: Aider auto-commits every edit with descriptive, '(aider)'-attributed messages so the developer can review or undo changes in git history, and `/git` gives raw git access for inspecting them. For checks, aider lints edited files by default, runs tests via `/test`, can auto-run a test suite after each edit with `--test-cmd`/`--auto-test`, and runs arbitrary commands with `/run`. Missing for 10: a dedicated in-chat diff-viewing command in the evidence (diff inspection relies on git history and raw git), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the review and check workflow.
